newsitem.title: USA: AZCO Mining acquires 51 percent of SANOU.
newsitem.headline: AZCO Mining acquires 51 percent of SANOU.

text.p: AZCO Mining Inc said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire 51 percent of the privately owned SANOU Mining Corporation, which holds 100 percent of the Medinandi and Dandoko concessions located in the Kenieba Gold Mining District of western Mali.
AZCO isssued a statement saying the Mali government has an option to acquire up to a 15 percent working interest in the concessions after completion of a favorable feasibility study.
The statement said predecessor exploration groups have estimated the mineral potential on the Medinandi concession alone to exceed one million ounces of gold.
